# 2 Clement — Chapter 9 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 9
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. And let none of you say that this flesh is not judged and does not rise again.
2. Know this: in what were you saved, in what did you recover your sight, if not while you were in this flesh?
3. We must therefore guard the flesh as a temple of God.
4. For in the same way as you were called in the flesh, you will also come in the flesh.
5. If Christ, the Lord who saved us, was first spirit and became flesh and in this manner called us, so also we shall receive the reward in this flesh.
6. Let us therefore love one another, so that we may all come to the kingdom of God.
7. While we have time to be healed, let us give ourselves over to God the healer, giving him a fee.
8. What is the fee? Repentance from a sincere heart.
9. For he knows all things in advance and knows what is in our hearts.
10. Let us therefore give him praise — not from our mouths only, but also from our hearts — so that he may receive us as sons.
